---
title: "Monthly Sightings Explorer (2005–2009)"
subtitle: "Explore five years of Sarasota Bay dolphin surveys by month, year, and pod size"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)

# Filter to the most recent 5 years in the OBIS dataset (2005-2009: 1,771 sightings)
recent_dolphins <- read_csv("data/sarasota_dolphins.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2005, year <= 2009) |>
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(month.name[month], levels = month.name),
    month_abb  = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      TRUE                   ~ "Autumn"
    ),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<strong>Date:</strong> ", event_date, "<br>",
      "<strong>Month:</strong> ", month_name, " ", year, "<br>",
      "<strong>Pod Size:</strong> ", group_size,
      ifelse(group_size == 1, " dolphin", " dolphins"), "<br>",
      "<strong>Coordinates:</strong> ", round(lat, 4), "°N, ", abs(round(lon, 4)), "°W"
    )
  )

shared_dolphins <- SharedData$new(recent_dolphins)

season_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c(
    "Winter" = "#2b5c8f",
    "Spring" = "#2a9d8f",
    "Summer" = "#e76f51",
    "Autumn" = "#e9c46a"
  ),
  levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")
)
```

Use the controls below to filter **1,771 boat-based dolphin sightings** recorded across the final five years of the published Sarasota Dolphin Research Program survey archive (**2005–2009**). Select specific months from the pull-down menu, toggle survey years, or slide the minimum pod size—then zoom into passes and bays on the map and click any sighting marker for details.

### Filter Sightings & Zoom the Bay

```{r}
filter_select(
  id = "month_filter",
  label = "Select Month(s) of the Year",
  sharedData = shared_dolphins,
  group = ~month_name
)

filter_checkbox(
  id = "year_filter",
  label = "Survey Year",
  sharedData = shared_dolphins,
  group = ~year,
  inline = TRUE
)

filter_slider(
  id = "pod_filter",
  label = "Pod Size (Number of Dolphins)",
  sharedData = shared_dolphins,
  column = ~group_size,
  step = 1,
  width = "100%"
)
```

```{r}
leaflet(shared_dolphins, height = 500) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  setView(lng = -82.58, lat = 27.36, zoom = 10) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~pmin(3 + sqrt(group_size) * 1.8, 14),
    color = ~season_pal(season),
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = season_pal,
    values = ~season,
    title = "Season",
    opacity = 0.85
  )
```

### Monthly Sightings & Total Dolphins Observed (2005–2009)

Hover over any point to compare monthly survey counts and average pod sizes across each of the five years, or click a year in the legend on the right to isolate or hide it.

```{r}
monthly_5yr <- recent_dolphins |>
  summarize(
    sightings = n(),
    total_dolphins = sum(group_size, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_pod = round(mean(group_size, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .by = c(year, month, month_abb)
  ) |>
  complete(year = 2005:2009, month = 1:12, fill = list(sightings = 0, total_dolphins = 0, avg_pod = 0)) |>
  mutate(
    month_abb = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb),
    year_label = as.character(year),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "<b>", month.name[month], " ", year, "</b><br>",
      "Sightings: ", sightings, "<br>",
      "Total dolphins counted: ", total_dolphins, "<br>",
      "Mean pod size: ", avg_pod
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(year, month)

plot_ly(
  data = monthly_5yr,
  x = ~month_abb,
  y = ~total_dolphins,
  color = ~year_label,
  colors = c("#264653", "#2a9d8f", "#8ab17d", "#f4a261", "#e76f51"),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  text = ~hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Total Dolphins Observed Each Month by Year (2005–2009)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Total Dolphins Observed"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Year")),
    hovermode = "closest"
  )
```
